_notes: ST LPS33HW / LPS35HW (Adafruit LPS3x boards) at 0x5D (default, SA0 high) or 0x5C. Also identifies the LPS22HB, which has the same WHO_AM_I (0xB1) and register map. Detection: WHO_AM_I (0x0F) = 0xB1. Init: reboot memory content (CTRL_REG2 0x11 = 0x90: BOOT, keeping IF_ADD_INC) to reload the trimming in the reserved registers, then software reset (0x11 = 0x14: SWRESET, keeping IF_ADD_INC so register reads auto-increment); RPDS_L/RPDS_H (0x18-0x19, the one-point calibration offset, subtracted as RPDS*256 from the pressure) and RES_CONF (0x1A) to their defaults of 0. Neither reset restores RPDS or RES_CONF, and SWRESET doesn't restore the reserved registers, so a write meant for another device can leave the chip reading wrongly until power is cycled: the RSAO identification hook's probe (written to register 0x99, which lands on 0x19 as bit 7 is ignored) set RPDS_H (64 hPa low) and reserved register 0x1B (about 12 hPa low; BOOT restores it). Then CTRL_REG1 (0x10) = 0x22: 10 Hz continuous, block data update. Poll: 6 bytes from STATUS (0x27): STATUS, PRESS_OUT_XL/L/H (24-bit, hPa = raw/4096), TEMP_OUT_L/H (signed, degC = raw/100). Unlike the LPS25, auto-increment is set in CTRL_REG2 rather than by bit 7 of the register address, and STATUS has P_DA in bit 0 and T_DA in bit 1.
